brief: Goldman Sachs prime brokerage and flow data for the week to 5 September 2026. US fundamental hedge fund net leverage sits in the 4th one-year percentile, and global gross leverage fell 1.9ppts to 304% while net leverage fell 0.5ppts to 76.4%, so the discretionary long/short book is not the marginal buyer. Long onlys show no re-risking and institutions were slight net sellers of S&P futures. The note argues the non-fundamental bid is losing steam: EPFR global equity fund inflows slowed to +$3bn from +$9bn with US and technology funds in outflow, CTA models sold $5.5bn of global equities leaving length at $139bn, and the buyback desk moderated to 1.2x 2025 year-to-date ADTV ahead of a Q3 blackout beginning around 15 September covering roughly 40% of the S&P 500. Sentiment is mildly pessimistic: the GS US Equity Sentiment Indicator turned negative at -0.1, CNN Fear and Greed fell to 42. Saboureault flags that as possible contrarian support given widely quoted weak September seasonals.
